description: Runs the CIVIL NX analysis of the open model (doc/ANAL), so results can be read with the result tools straight after building or changing a model. Replaces the model's results; changes no model data. The model must have been saved to a file at least once (the API cannot analyse an unsaved model): saveFirst: true saves it over its file first. Previews unless apply: true. Can take minutes on a large model.

apply.description: Run it. Only with the user's go-ahead.

saveFirst.description: Save the model over its own file before analysing (doc/SAVE).

name: civil_run_analysis
title: Run the analysis
